notes.title: Trizon is now available!
notes.content:
Trizon, my first independently developed anime-style roguelike deckbuilding game, was officially released. The game supports English, Chinese, Japanese, and Portuguese.

Price: $8.99
Launch discount: 10% off, now $8.10 for the first week.

You can also get Trizon in a bundle with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1915510/]Yao-Guai Hunter[/url] at a discounted price:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53934

Watch the trailer: [url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1rBEezFERB/]Click here[/url]

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Sacrifice: Inspired by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1092790/_/]Inscryption[/url], sacrifice creatures to pay costs.
[*] Fusion: Merge any two cards from your deck to create a new one with combined effects.
[*] Plot: Meet with other NPCs during your adventure. Are they friends or enemies?
[/list]

If Trizon interests you, purchasing or adding it to your wishlist would greatly support me as a solo developer。

notes.title: Deckbuilding Roguelike Game Trizon Demo Released!
notes.content:
Hello, card game fans!

The demo for Trizon, a roguelike deckbuilding game, is now available and will be featured at February's Next Fest. You can try the latest demo on the store page now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3064290/Trizon/

Trizon is a roguelike card-building game with anime-style illustrations of cute characters. You play as an escapee, moving forward to escape and uncover the world's truth. Along the way, you'll encounter various NPCs who are transformed into cards. Collect them, unlock new stories, and add them to your deck to help you on your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195493/ba5a668ee9323672aea4afa4cafd0b185e2e67d7.png[/img]

Fuse any two cards to discover unique synergies, and experiment with endless combinations as you dive deeper into the world’s mysteries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195493/1c7b5fa2352b74524da777172d466742537d718a.png[/img]

[b]Demo features:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Three maps with encounters, events, and card fusion, etc.
[*]50+ anime girl cards, 6 boss variants, and 30+ monster cards.
[*]High strategy and replayability with free card fusion.
[/list]

Try the demo now! If you’re excited about Trizon, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/jYVM85bxdF]Discord channel[/url] and add Trizon to your wishlist for support!
